title: [review] project-LICHEN-worker6-p19p: compilation error in lichen-schc headers.rs
description:
## Bug

The commit 87f27c9 changed `write_ipv6_header` signature to accept `(traffic_class, flow_label)` as a tuple `flow: (u8, u32)`, and updated 3 of 4 call sites. The 4th call site at `headers.rs:989` was missed, causing compilation failure:

```
error[E0061]: function takes 7 arguments but 8 arguments were supplied
   --> lichen-schc/src/headers.rs:989:9
```

### Fix applied
Wrapped `traffic_class, flow_label` in parentheses at the remaining call site.

### Severity
P0 — cannot compile the crate.
